scenarios.name: Message history refreshes without duplicating rows

steps.text: an authenticated organization operator using mocked history data
the operator opens message history and requests a refresh
exactly one additional message request is made
each server message is rendered once

scenarios.name: Webhook history keys represent the complete request

steps.text: an authenticated organization operator using mocked history data
the operator opens webhook delivery history and requests a refresh
the webhook request contains every active filter dimension
exactly one additional webhook request is made

scenarios.name: A delayed response cannot cross an organization switch

steps.text: an authenticated operator with delayed Organization A history
the active browser context changes to Organization B
only Organization B history is rendered
the delayed Organization A request is cancelled and cannot reappear
